summary: Set a FileMaker global field before another operation or script.
purpose: Use this when you need a reviewed code sample for FileMaker global state and want a clear warning that it is not a read-only action.
learningGoals: Understand that FileMaker globals change state even though they may look small and harmless.
Preserve exact FileMaker field names when setting global values.
Make the Data API dependency explicit for this operation.
explanation: Global field changes are stateful and can influence later requests or scripts, so this module remains code-only. It teaches the payload shape without implying that globals are safe to run from a browser sandbox.
commonMistakes: Treating a global field like a harmless local setting.
Changing the field name into a friendly label.
Expecting OData to offer the same helper path for globals.
expectedResult: You get a reviewed starter snippet for setting a FileMaker global field, but the playground will not run it live.

safety.confirmationText: Global field changes affect later behavior. Review the field name, value, and environment before running this code.

prerequisites: Know how the target global field affects your FileMaker workflows.
Use reviewable demo values while learning the pattern.

inputs.label: Global field name
inputs.help: Use the exact FileMaker global field name, including any table occurrence prefix if your project requires it.

inputs.label: Global value
inputs.help: Use the value that should be written into the global field.

beginner: Global fields change FileMaker state, so this module only generates code for review.
Keep the real global field name exactly as FileMaker expects it.
Switch to the PHP Data API variant if you need the executable starter pattern.
advanced: The OData PHP branch intentionally stays comment-only to match the legacy generator and avoid false feature parity.
Global writes are side-effecting even when the payload is tiny.
No JavaScript variant is supported because the browser learning panel stays read-only.
